purpose: Define a language-neutral conformance-driver boundary so the exact #130 symbolic traces can be replayed against Python AnumMemory, a future PMM adapter, and other backends without putting L2/L3 semantics or physical identity into the storage driver.

layers: L3 fixture compiler only when a trace references sourceRaw/context

wire.transportCandidate: deterministic UTF-8 JSON objects; JSONL process framing is the first external-driver candidate

request.id: caller-chosen opaque string used only to correlate response

capabilities.negotiation: hello response returns booleans for the complete known capability set

operationSurface.hello: return protocol schema and capabilities; no state mutation
operationSurface.create: initialize one workspace from a closed symbolic seed graph
operationSurface.snapshot: return normalized symbolic live topology; no backend handles
operationSurface.find_link: read exact pair; return symbolic binding or null; never realize
operationSurface.outgoing: read normalized set of symbolic link names
operationSurface.incoming: read normalized set of symbolic link names
operationSurface.realize_link: explicit exact-pair realization and scenario-local symbolic bind
operationSurface.realize_structural_denotation: explicit atomic realization from anum-denotation/v0.2 structural IR, external anchor-name bindings and deterministic scenario-local node bindings

symbolicBinding.meaning: driver-side alias from scenario-local name to opaque backend handle
symbolicBinding.normalizedRef: lexicographically smallest currently bound scenario name for a live handle
symbolicBinding.reason: harness metadata must never create a backend write that is later reported as a protocol-level binding failure

snapshotNormalization.shape: sorted array of {ref,start,end} using normalized symbolic names
snapshotNormalization.sortKey: ref then start then end as Unicode strings

structuralDenotationBoundary.wireInput: canonical data shape from anum-denotation/v0.2 with kind=structural
structuralDenotationBoundary.compilePipeline: parse_raw_quaternary -> denotate_recursive_anum(explicit context) -> canonical structural IR before driver dispatch
structuralDenotationBoundary.nodeBindings: request supplies deterministic scenario-local names for every description-local node id so newly realized internal links are observable without exposing backend handles
structuralDenotationBoundary.rootBinding: request may add a scenario-local alias for the resolved denotation root
structuralDenotationBoundary.bindingPreflight: existing scenario names are validated against an already-complete read-only denotation lookup before realization; inconsistent metadata fails before write
structuralDenotationBoundary.atomicity: backend adapter must not expose partial new links if validation/anchor resolution/write fails

referenceImplementation.purpose: challenge protocol and normalization only; not a second L4 semantics

vetoes: raw [ ] 1 0 appears on driver request wire
ProjectionContext appears on driver request wire
raw backend handle appears in normalized response
physical pointer/offset/record id becomes expected identity
binding conflict is detected only after a backend write
test harness fakes persistence for a non-persistent backend
driver buffers writes so backend partial-commit bugs are hidden from crash-recovery tests
PMM-specific field is added to canonical #130 traces

nextGate.artifact: PMM-backed external driver using this protocol
